messages.author: Nicy yadav
messages.body:
Hi,
I am getting the following error when I am trying to use pdb4amber-
Traceback (most recent call last):
File "/home/xxxx/AMBER20/amber20/bin/pdb4amber", line 33, in <module>
sys.exit(load_entry_point('pdb4amber==1.7.dev0', 'console_scripts',
'pdb4amber')())
File "/home/xxxx/AMBER20/amber20/bin/pdb4amber", line 22, in
importlib_load_entry_point
for entry_point in distribution(dist_name).entry_points
File
"/home/xxxx/AMBER20/amber20/miniconda/lib/python3.8/importlib/metadata.py",
line 504, in distribution
return Distribution.from_name(distribution_name)
File
"/home/xxxx/AMBER20/amber20/miniconda/lib/python3.8/importlib/metadata.py",
line 177, in from_name
raise PackageNotFoundError(name)
importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError: pdb4amber
I tried to check about it in previous emails on AMBER mailing list, I tried
running update_amber --help and also I tried re-running run_cmake. But I am
still getting this error. Can you please help me with this and let me know
what exactly needs to be done?
Thanks and best regards,
Nicy

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Wed, Jan 27, 2021, Scott Brozell wrote:
>On Mon, Jan 25, 2021 at 04:24:33PM +0000, Nicy yadav wrote:
>> importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError: pdb4amber
Scott's link to a very long discussion may be what you need.  But let's
check the most likely problem first: did you do this after make install:?
cd ../../amber20   (or where you installed the code; this is the default)
source amber.sh
This will set your AMBERHOME and PYTHONPATH variables.  You have to do this
every time you login, so it's recommended that you put these commands into
your ~/.bashrc or other startup scripts.
....good luck....dac
